messages:
erin: Quick follow-up on the span-loss postmortem. I pulled together an action list from the meeting. Short items:

alex: thanks, please paste the list here

erin: 1) stabilize ETL consumer retry logic - owner: alex - ETA: 2026-04-02
2) reingest missing spans for 2026-03-10..2026-03-14 - owner: maria + jason - ETA: 2026-03-28
3) add aggregation guardrails (null-safe counters) - owner: jason - ETA: 2026-04-05
4) add span-coverage daily monitor + pager - owner: lisa - ETA: 2026-03-26
5) postmortem doc + TL;DR for impacted customers - owner: erin - ETA: 2026-03-25

maria: reingest plan: we'll run a targeted backfill using the replay job. steps:
- snapshot keys -> validate checksums
- run replay with --dry-run then small window
- verify via sample queries

jason: aggregation guardrails: dropping sums when grouping keys are NULL was the root cause. patch is small, will add unit tests and a regression eval.

alex: retry logic: current consumer swallows errors on 429s. plan is exponential backoff + cursor persist to S3 prefix + alert on repeated failures.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to staging 2026-03-23T18:00Z. If failure >1% revert automatically.

lisa: monitor: adding a check that raises pager when daily span count drops >5% and aggregation drift >2% compared to baseline.

erin: blockers? infra quotas for the reingest job may need a short-term bump.

jason: @infra-team can we get a GPU quota bump for 6 hours next week? (will only need CPU workers but want headroom)

ops-bot: @infra-team request recorded: ticket #INF-1429

maria: sample query to validate backfill:

```
SELECT count(*) FROM spans
WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-14'
AND service = 'api-proxy';
```

jason: timeline looks tight but doable. recommend we schedule the reingest in a low-traffic window (weekend overnight).

erin: let's lock owners to these ETAs and do a 3x/week check-in until complete. I'll post a calendar invite and update the postmortem doc.

alex: ack. I'll open PR for retry logic today and tag @code-review.

lisa: I'll create the monitor and runbook, will add runbook steps for on-call to triage a span drop.

maria: will start the dry-run reingest tomorrow and share artifacts.

erin: thanks all. next check-in Friday 14:00 PT. If anything slips, escalate here. :thumbsup:
